releaseNotes: Pen and marker ink now renders above positioned text blocks so handwritten notes and highlights can cross typed text
Text blocks become editable only in Text mode while remaining transparent in Pen and Marker modes
Ink löschen now requires an explicit confirmation before clearing handwriting and marker strokes
Notiz löschen now requires an explicit confirmation before deleting the complete note and all pages
No new APK is required; Shell 1.1.0 remains sufficient
